governing_principle: A true world fact does not automatically authorize conditioning, source choice, probability change, uncertainty collapse, or individual-state inference.

f8_algorithm_finding.consequence: F8 performs NO geometry computation. Geometry arrives pre-materialized on PossibilitySliceEvidence.geometry and is only SELECTED by exact (source_universe, release, target, retained_conditioner_ids) match, or by a governed strictly-decreasing specificity walkback within the same source/release.
f8_algorithm_finding.therefore: GEOMETRY_TRANSFORMER and DISTRIBUTION_TRANSFORMER are NOT_AVAILABLE_AT_F8 for any world input family. Geometry transformation authority, where it exists, is UPSTREAM at the producer.

operations.description: Bind an exact objective fact as a conditioning coordinate of a positioned-subject possibility query.
operations.refusal_on_absence: ConditionerBinding.__post_init__ raises PositionedSubjectPossibilityError on missing comparability authority; there is no default-allow and no fuzzy/latest resolution.

operations.description: Change the possibility geometry or distribution returned for a subject.
operations.required_authority: NOT AVAILABLE AT F8 — no positive authority exists or is needed because F8 does not compute geometry
operations.owner: upstream producer (C1 analytical composition; NOT PRESENT at control tip)
operations.refusal_on_absence: n/a at F8; upstream absence yields EXACT_POSITIONED_STRATUM_ABSENT -> UNRESOLVED, or FAIL_CLOSED when the query source universe is out of model scope.
operations.note: This is the single most important H-D finding: because F8 is exact-lookup-only, a world product CANNOT change F8 geometry even if a rule were written, unless the upstream producer materializes a new evidence slice at a new retained_conditioner_ids grain.

operations.description: Broaden the conditioning basis to a coarser authorized grain when the exact stratum is absent.
required_authority: positive_proxy_authority_refs list that must contain every step authority
operations.refusal_on_absence: Ladder must strictly decrease; a non-decreasing step raises. A step whose source_universe_ref or release_ref differs from the query yields FAIL_CLOSED / FAIL_CLOSED_UNAUTHORIZED_PROXY_SOURCE with reason 'V1 proxies may not cross source universe or release'.
operations.note: Walkback output is EXACT_UNRESOLVED_PROXY_AVAILABLE. The exact lane remains unresolved; proxy_can_satisfy_exact_request is False. This is the ONLY mechanism by which a coarser world context may reach F8, and it can never manufacture support.

operations.description: Choose which source/universe/release is permissible for a given service, target, time, geography or population.
operations.current_behaviour: VALIDATION_ONLY. evaluate_positioned_subject_possibility checks membership of query.source_universe_ref in rule.source_universe_refs and otherwise FAIL_CLOSED with MODEL_SOURCE_UNIVERSE_OUT_OF_SCOPE. The rule's source set is caller/owner supplied; nothing selects it.
operations.refusal_on_absence: FAIL_CLOSED (out-of-scope universe) — a refusal, not a selection.
operations.audit_corroboration: MATRIX W16 = UNKNOWN__FURTHER_FORENSICS_REQUIRED; 'precise missing proof, not proved missing form'.
operations.cross_reference: This is the H-C lane. H-D records the dependency and does not pre-empt H-C's answer.

operations.description: Compose multiple sources/universes into one possibility input.
operations.refusal_on_absence: cross_source_proxy = FORBIDDEN_IN_V1; proxy steps crossing source universe or release are refused structurally.
operations.note: Lawful cross-source coexistence WITHOUT pooling exists in source-indexed mode (SOURCE_INDEXED_MULTI_UNIVERSE), per HQ203 recalibration item 1. That is CONTEXT_ONLY. AUTHORIZED_COMPOSITE is a separate branch and is not inherited by coexistence.

operations.description: Floor, average, or renormalize typed uncertainty into a confident value.
operations.refusal_on_absence: evaluate_current_consumer raises RenormalizationForbidden('no coefficient/confidence/semantic-scope renormalization') when renormalization_requested is true. ClaimCeiling._satisfies refuses to upgrade a ceiling (POPULATION_STATISTIC cannot satisfy OBJECTIVE_FACT or STRUCTURAL_RELATION).
operations.note: This is the load-bearing refusal that makes CONTEXT_ONLY safe: a world fact that merely accompanies a result cannot silently tighten the distribution.

operations.description: Convert an admitted empirical fact into an actor-independent structural proposition.
operations.refusal_on_absence: 12-state DECISION_PRECEDENCE with typed precedence; 11 of 12 states are nonpositive. Rule construction itself raises if TARGET_USE_PERMISSION is absent, or if TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE/WEIGHT_DESIGN_ESTIMAND are required but unbound.
operations.explicit_non_authority: P06/I04 explicitly does NOT decide temporal operations and does NOT mint temporal objects (p06_i04_decides_temporal_operations = False, p06_i04_mints_temporal_objects = False). Admission is not ontology derivation.
operations.conservation_note: AdmissionCondition docstring: 'I04 may preserve and order such a condition; it may not invent the upstream fact, source, measure, temporal, or comparability authority behind it.'

operations.description: Map an exact objective fact in one domain onto an empirical predicate in another, to serve as an F8 conditioner.
operations.required_authority: GT34_OBL031_ADP010_Q69B_FIELD_SPECIFIC_COMPARATOR_AUTHORITY@1.1.3, consuming OBL057 D08 grammar at exactly GT34_D08_EMPIRICAL_PREDICATE_GRAMMAR_AUTHORITY@1.0.0
operations.refusal_on_absence: A missing authorized encounter yields a typed refusal; it must not fabricate a predicate.
operations.note: OBL031 is a positive authority EXAMPLE at one field, not universal mapping coverage. Every additional target field needs its own competent mapping and evidence.

operations.description: Derive a realized actor state, personality, belief, memory or individual prediction from objective possibility.
operations.required_authority: FORBIDDEN — no authority form exists or may be created at PRE-V3
operations.refusal_on_absence: Structural, not advisory: query purpose must equal EMPIRICAL_POSSIBILITY_ONLY; actor_inference_allowed = False in model rule material; FORBIDDEN_INTERPRETATION_MARKERS reject ACTOR_BELIEF/ACTOR_MEMORY/ACTOR_PSYCHE/GENERATED_ACTOR_POSITION at rule construction.

operations_forbidden_at_current_grain: GEOMETRY_CHANGE (not performed at F8 at all)
summary.basis: MATRIX C17 and W16 both state the FORM is closed while the INSTANCE or PROOF remains. HQD-125 s15 forbids reopening architecture merely because a gate lacks live occupancy.
